_readme: Golden test fixture for the hub graph: real public metadata about montelukast labels, gathered 17-18 Oct 2026
from DailyMed web services (SPL history, archived SPL zips), the openFDA NDC Directory, openFDA drug labels and Drugs@FDA.
No label text is stored: only identifiers, dates, section codes and the Matcher's result per version.
Load with the I-queries in docs/queries.cypher in this order: molecules (I1), applications (I2), holders (I3),
label_sets (I4), versions (I5), products (I6), describes (I7), packages (I8), sourced_from (I9), facts (I11),
derive references (I12 with molecule_key), checks (I10), label of record (I13 with today_d).
Dates ending _d are days since 1970-01-01. as_of is the day the data was read.
